name: mast
description: A Socratic machine-learning debugging tutor for VS Code.

commands.title: MAST: Run Python and Capture Error

mast.modelDirectory.description: Optional local directory containing the MAST ONNX files and metadata.json. Empty uses packaged synthetic assets, with a repository artifact fallback for development.

mast.gatewayUrl.description: MAST Gateway base URL. Remote URLs must use HTTPS; HTTP is accepted only for localhost development.

mast.telemetryEnabled.description: Share derived interaction metadata with the MAST Gateway for product metrics. Message, error, and code content are never sent to telemetry endpoints.

enumDescriptions: Use the provider key stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
mast.authMode.description: Credential mode for later MAST generation features. Block 7 does not send BYOK keys anywhere.

mast.pythonCommand.description: Python executable path used only by MAST: Run Python and Capture Error. It is launched without a shell.

walkthroughs.title: Your first MAST question
walkthroughs.description: Sign in, open the chat, and work through your first machine-learning error. MAST's managed flow never asks for a provider API key.

steps.title: Sign in with GitHub
steps.description: Connect your MAST account. The managed cloud flow uses MAST's server-side provider and does not require your API key.

steps.title: Open MAST Chat
steps.description: Open the MAST Chat panel to describe a machine-learning error or question.

steps.title: Ask your first question
steps.description: Paste an error or ask about a concept in Chat. MAST responds with a focused Socratic question.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/auth.test.js out/test/block11.test.js out/test/chat.test.js out/test/inference.test.js out/test/packaging.test.js out/test/retrieval.test.js
